fee_notes: Single territory fee is $59,500. Additional territories available at tiered rates: Territory #2 $40,000, Territory #3 $35,000, Territory #4-5 $30,000 each. Overage fee of $0.30 per capita for population exceeding cumulative benchmarks. Fee is non-refundable and deemed earned upon execution.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $59,500 (the 'Initial Franchise Fee') when you sign the Franchise Agreement, which includes a Protected Territory of approximately 200,000 in total general population.
